Priya: Hey team — customer Acme reporting repeated 401 "invalid_api_key" from hosted endpoints but the same key works from their laptop via curl. Started after a key rotation earlier today. They run a long‑running worker with connection pooling. Any obvious causes?

acme_oncall: Seeing ~5% of requests return 401 after rotation, then recover after 10–30s. Worker uses our Python SDK which keeps a requests.Session open (pool_size=10). No external proxy.

Ethan: Can you paste SDK version and a minimal repro? My first thought: keep‑alive connection reuse that still has the old Authorization header attached.

acme_oncall: Repro snippet from their worker: `python -c "import requests; s=requests.Session(); s.headers.update({'Authorization':'Bearer NEWKEY'}); r=s.post('https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate',json={'prompt':'hi'}); print(r.status_code, r.text)"` Runs fine when done fresh, but in their system the session lives across a key rotation and some requests after rotation fail.

Kai: On our edge I'm seeing logs for those 401s with `auth_cache_hit:false` and `auth_key_id:old_key_id` — looks like the TLS connection/keepalive carried the old auth header. LB isn't rewriting Authorization. Asking infra if any proxy could rewind headers, but most likely client reuse. Can you have them try adding `Connection: close` to confirm?

Priya: I've asked them to retry with `Connection: close` and to restart one worker process. They sent back trace id for a failing request: `trace_abc123`.

Ethan: Quick mitigation: SDK should invalidate the session pool on 401 from auth checks and retry once with a fresh session. I'll open a PR to implement session invalidation + single retry. In the short term tell them to restart their workers or call `session.close()` after rotation. Also adding a helper `redwood.rotate_key()` to our SDK docs to show recommended flow.

Kai: Infra action — we should return a clearer error when a request fails due to connection reuse vs an actually banned/expired key. Filing an infra ticket to add an explicit `stale_connection_after_rotation` subcode instead of generic `invalid_api_key`.

deploy-bot: Created tickets INF-2026 (infra) and SDK-4023 (sdk) :thumbsup:

Priya: Customer restarted their worker and error rate dropped to 0. They asked for a short KB entry on best practices for key rotation with long‑lived sessions. Action items: (1) SDK retry/invalid-session patch (Ethan), (2) infra return clearer subcode (Kai), (3) support KB + docs note (Priya). Marking as resolved for now and will follow up when PR/ticket land.
